$comment: Central config for diff_rulesets.py. Applied to BOTH the resolved-local and live-remote rulesets. 'strip' removes top-level fields entirely before comparing (volatile / server-assigned / per-repo identity — never a drift signal). 'ignore' silences new/removed-key warnings at specific dotted paths that have already been triaged (e.g. "rules.pull_request.parameters.some_new_github_field").
